name: com.getmcpads/meta-ads
title: Meta Ads
description: Meta Ads MCP server: 41 read tools, 23 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: META_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Meta access token with at least the ads_read permission.

environmentVariables.name: META_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose 23 write tools. Default calls preview; confirm:true applies changes.

environmentVariables.name: META_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Graph API version. Defaults to v26.0.
